resize.note: If max(h,w) >= 736, scale so the long side is 736 (ratio = 736/max(h,w)); otherwise keep the original size (ratio = 1). resize_h = int(h*ratio), resize_w = int(w*ratio).

normalize.note: value = (pixel/255 - mean) / std, applied on the 0..255 BGR image; equivalent to (BGR - mean*255) * (1/std/255) used by sophon-demo.

padding.note: The resized image is written to the top-left corner of a 736x736 zero canvas; the remainder stays 0 (post-normalisation zeros, not grey).

postprocess.name: DBPostProcess
postprocess.note: Values are from the model's own inference.yml (PostProcess). sophon-demo's PP-OCR python sample hardcodes thresh=0.3/box_thresh=0.6/unclip_ratio=1.5 for PP-OCRv4; PP-OCRv6's shipped inference.yml is authoritative for v6 and is what the golden uses.
postprocess.output_maps: Probability map cropped back to [0:resize_h, 0:resize_w] before contour extraction; boxes are scaled by (src_w/resize_w, src_h/resize_h) back to the original image.

width_selection.note: ratio = crop_w / crop_h. Pick the narrowest tier whose max_ratio is >= ratio * 1.15. The 1.15 factor lets a slightly-longer line use the narrower model, which is cheaper; anything wider than 33.33:1 uses 1600 and is truncated there. 640 alone is NOT enough: it squashes a 34.8:1 line to a 2.3x horizontal squeeze and the recogniser returns garbage -- the same crop at 1600 decodes correctly. 1600 covers every line in the golden set. The model's own inference.yml declares dynamic support up to 3200; a 3200 tier was compiled and measured to give the same text as 1600 on these images, so it is not shipped (2x the time steps for no accuracy).

resize.note: resized_w = int(48 * w / h), width only; no height change.

normalize.note: value = (pixel - 127.5) * 0.0078125, i.e. (pixel/255 - 0.5)/0.5. This is the RecResizeImg/NormalizeImage default in PaddleOCR's rec config, and matches the bmodel compiled from the same preprocessing.

padding.note: Right-pad to the tier width with 0.

postprocess.name: CTCLabelDecode
steps: argmax over the class axis -> index per time step
map the remaining indices through labels[]
confidence = mean of the per-step softmax maxima of the kept steps
postprocess.labels_note: labels[] is ['<blank>'] + ppocr_keys_v1.txt (18708 lines) + [' ']. 1 + 18708 + 1 = 18710 classes, matching the model output. The space character is appended because use_space_char defaults to true in PP-OCR rec; it is NOT present in the dictionary file itself.
postprocess.softmax_note: The bmodel output is already softmaxed (Softmax is the graph's last op). The ONNX graph also ends in Softmax, so argmax/confidence are directly comparable between the two.

cls.note: No direction-classification model is used. The PP-OCRv6 det+rec path in sophon-demo sample/PP-OCR does not invoke cls; angle handling is left to the caller. Deliberately not built.
